title: Pixar Easy Wins
description: Beginner-friendly Pixar trivia — Toy Story, Finding Nemo, the basics.

questions.prompt: In Toy Story, what is the name of Andy's cowboy doll?
questions.explanation: Woody is a pull-string sheriff doll from a fictional 1950s TV show called Woody's Roundup, revealed in Toy Story 2 (1999).

questions.prompt: In Toy Story, what is the name of the space ranger action figure?
questions.explanation: Buzz is named after astronaut Buzz Aldrin, the second person to walk on the moon — Pixar got permission from Aldrin himself.

questions.prompt: What kind of fish is Nemo in Finding Nemo?
questions.explanation: Finding Nemo (2003) caused a real-world spike in clownfish sales as pets, which ironically harmed wild reef populations.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Nemo's father?
questions.explanation: Marlin is voiced by Albert Brooks; the name is a fish pun, since marlin is also a species of large saltwater fish.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the race car hero in Cars?
questions.explanation: Lightning McQueen is voiced by Owen Wilson and named in tribute to Pixar animator Glenn McQueen, who died in 2002.

questions.prompt: What kind of vehicle is Mater in Cars?
questions.explanation: Mater is a rusty 1950s-era tow truck voiced by Larry the Cable Guy; his name is a play on 'tow-mater' (tomato).

questions.prompt: In Monsters, Inc., what is the name of the big blue furry monster?
questions.explanation: Sulley is voiced by John Goodman; his full name is James P. Sullivan and his blue fur required Pixar to invent new simulation tech for 2.3 million hairs.

questions.prompt: In The Incredibles, what is the family's last name?
questions.explanation: The surname 'Parr' is a play on 'par' as in average — a wink at the family hiding as ordinary suburbanites despite their powers.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the baby in The Incredibles?
questions.explanation: Jack-Jack's many powers (laser eyes, fire, teleport, shape-shifting) are fully revealed in Incredibles 2 (2018), 14 years after the original.

questions.prompt: In Up, what is the name of the young Wilderness Explorer who tags along with Carl?
questions.explanation: Russell is voiced by Jordan Nagai, who was eight when cast; director Pete Docter picked him because he wouldn't stop talking at the audition.

questions.prompt: How does Carl's house fly in Up?
questions.explanation: Pixar animators calculated that lifting a real house would actually require around 100,000 helium balloons, not the few thousand shown on screen.

questions.prompt: In WALL-E, what is the name of the sleek white robot WALL-E falls in love with?
questions.explanation: EVE stands for Extraterrestrial Vegetation Evaluator; her smooth iPod-like design was created with help from Apple's Jonathan Ive.

questions.prompt: In Coco, what is the name of the main character who dreams of being a musician?
questions.explanation: Miguel is voiced by Anthony Gonzalez, who was 12 during recording; Pixar spent six years researching Mexican culture for the film.

questions.prompt: What Mexican holiday is Coco set during?
questions.explanation: Día de los Muertos honors deceased loved ones on November 1-2; Coco (2017) became the highest-grossing film ever in Mexico at its release.

questions.prompt: In Inside Out, what is the name of the young girl whose emotions we see?
questions.explanation: Riley was inspired by director Pete Docter's real daughter Elie, who also voiced young Ellie in Up (2009).

questions.prompt: In Brave, what is the name of the red-haired princess?
questions.explanation: Merida was Pixar's first female protagonist and is voiced by Kelly Macdonald; her wild curly hair required custom-built simulation software.

questions.prompt: What country is Brave set in?
questions.explanation: Brave (2012) is set in the medieval Scottish Highlands; Pixar's crew traveled to Scotland for two research trips to study landscape and culture.

questions.prompt: In Ratatouille, what city is the film set in?
questions.explanation: Director Brad Bird ate at every Michelin-starred restaurant in Paris during research, and Thomas Keller of The French Laundry consulted on the food.

questions.prompt: In A Bug's Life, what kind of insect is the main character Flik?
questions.explanation: A Bug's Life (1998) was Pixar's second feature; it released the same year as DreamWorks' Antz, sparking a long rivalry between the studios.

questions.prompt: In Finding Dory, what kind of animal is Hank, the creature that helps Dory?
questions.explanation: Hank is technically a 'septopus' since he's missing a tentacle; animating him was so complex Pixar called him their hardest character ever.

questions.prompt: In Luca, what kind of creature is Luca when he's underwater?
questions.explanation: Director Enrico Casarosa based Luca (2021) on his own childhood summers in the Italian Riviera town of Genoa.

questions.prompt: In Turning Red, what animal does Mei transform into?
questions.explanation: Turning Red (2022) was directed by Domee Shi, the first woman to solo-direct a Pixar feature; the red panda is a metaphor for puberty.

questions.prompt: In Onward, what mythical creatures are the two brothers?
questions.explanation: Onward (2020) was one of the last films to screen in theaters before COVID closures; the elf brothers Ian and Barley are voiced by Tom Holland and Chris Pratt.

questions.prompt: In Soul, what is the main character Joe's profession?
questions.explanation: Joe Gardner is a middle-school band teacher who dreams of being a jazz pianist; he's voiced by Jamie Foxx, Pixar's first Black lead character.

questions.prompt: In Elemental, the two main characters represent which two elements?
questions.explanation: Director Peter Sohn based Ember and Wade on his own experience as the child of Korean immigrants in New York; Elemental released in 2023.
